title: Your Repair Was Ready Two Days Ago
idea: One Status Filter Shows Which Finished Repairs Can Go Home Today.
caption:
A Finished Repair Should Not Sit On A Shelf. One Status Filter Shows What Can Go Home Today.

Filmed In A Demo Queue With Sample Jobs. Your Software May Name The Filter Differently.

Demo: example.com/repair-queue

openings.second_sentence: All Three Repairs Were Already Done.

openings.first_sentence: This List Is Every Repair Ready Today.

beats.voice: Your Repair Was Ready Two Days Ago.
beats.picture: A Finished Phone On A Shelf With A Dated Ticket
beats.capture: Close Shot Of The Shelf Ticket With Its Finish Date In Focus

beats.voice: The Shop Just Could Not See It.
beats.picture: A Queue Screen Listing Every Job In One Long Column
beats.capture: Screen Recording Of The Unfiltered Queue, Scrolled Once

beats.voice: Forty Jobs Share One List, So A Finished One Hides Between Two Broken Ones.
beats.picture: One Ready Row Circled Between Two Waiting Rows
beats.capture: The Same Recording Paused On The Ready Row

beats.voice: Here Is The Fix. Filter The Queue By One Status.

beats.capture: Screen Recording Of The Menu Opening

beats.voice: Select Ready Only, And The List Drops To The Jobs That Can Leave Today.
beats.picture: The Queue Shrinks From Forty Rows To Three
beats.capture: One Unbroken Screen Recording Across The Click

beats.voice: Call Those Three First, And Nobody Waits On A Repair That Is Already Done.

beats.capture: Over-The-Shoulder Shot Of The Call Being Placed
